docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Sanskrit text of the treatise on statecraft ascribed to Kauṭilya, with a commentary, in the Trivandrum Sanskrit Series (1924).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised for the Digital Library of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Arthasastra Of Kautalya Pt.ii -1 And 2 · Sastri, T. Ganapati · 1924, 406 scanned pages. Published 1924; edited by T. Ganapati Sastri (died 1926); public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
